_comment: Release-tree profile for scripts/check-language.mjs. Extends guard-allow.json so both scopes share one allow list and one ruling history; only scan scope and the disabled rule set differ. Run by run_all.sh step 8 as: node scripts/check-language.mjs --config scripts/guard-spec.json --root . --ship none
_ruling: 2026-08-24. The site ruleset polices marketing voice. Normative specification text legitimately describes enforcement mechanics, uses guarantee and prove as technical terms, and names integrity-level mechanisms that DSES v0.1 published on 2026-08-15 under CC BY 4.0. Those rules are therefore disabled for the release tree. The rules that describe legal exposure or objective hygiene (false patent marking, registered-mark symbol before registration, forbidden domains and mark phrases, doctoral abbreviation, em dash, the two prohibited insurance claims) stay armed. Bare-noun DSES and insurance-disclaimer stay on as warnings.

ignorePaths.reason: working notes, not shipped; make_release.py does not include docs/

_scanExt_ruling: 2026-08-24. The release tree carries prose inside schema descriptions, CITATION.cff, docstrings and shell comments; the hygiene rules apply there too.
